state.paragraph: In late July 2016, the Company received six LOIs with offer prices per share ranging from $19.20 to $24.00 (implying equity values of $96 million to $121 million). Party B, G&W and another bidder ("Party D") also provided mark-ups of the draft merger agreement and voting agreement. One bidder ("Party E") provided a summary of material issues and proposed changes to the merger agreement and voting agreement with respect to those issues.

ledger_rows.Note: IOI deadline moved from 05/10 to 05/19 so buyers could formulate their most compelling offers.
Revised IOI due date reached; recommended outcome is Enforced, subject to Q2.
25 initial signers − 9 IOI submitters = 16; may include Party A. Count becomes 17 if Party B was an additional signer (Q3).
Non-binding preliminary IOIs before substantive diligence; aggregate range only, so no bidder receives an endpoint.
Transaction Committee excluded the two low bidders from management presentations and further diligence.
Seven remaining bidders advanced to management presentations and the data site for additional diligence.
LOIs due 07/20 with markups of the merger agreement, disclosure letter and voting agreement.
Late entrant approached management about acquiring the whole Company; no price at first contact.
New entrant; received the same Company memorandum as other potential buyers.
IOI preceded data-site and management access; implied equity value $108 million.
Catch-up access: data site and a 07/14 telephone management presentation after its late entry.
LOI with merger- and voting-agreement markups; expedited diligence review.
LOI sought 60-day exclusivity for diligence and documents; supplied an issues summary, not reported agreement markups.
LOI with merger- and voting-agreement markups; required four weeks of diligence.
LOI due date reached; G&W’s 07/21 LOI was considered, so recommended outcome is Late bids accepted.
$20.02 cash plus bidder-valued $1.13 CVR; merger/voting markups and disclosure-letter markup; requested three-week exclusive diligence.
$21.02 cash plus bidder-valued $1.13 CVR; formal status and three-week exclusive diligence carried from #33.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
